chunks: We revealed to Moses: 'Throw down your staff;' and immediately it swallowed up what they were fabricating (of conjurations).
ai.seo_question: What did Moses' staff do when it was thrown down before Pharaoh's magicians?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-A'raf, this verse highlights the divine revelation ('wahy') to Moses, emphasizing the contrast between the 'illicit' magic of Pharaoh's court and the authentic miracle of the staff. Shia exegetes often note that the staff 'swallowing' their illusions signifies the triumph of divine truth over human fabrication, a theme resonating with the concept of 'batin' (inner reality) overcoming 'zahir' (apparent form). This event serves as a precursor to the Israelites' eventual exodus, reinforcing Moses' authority as a prophet chosen by God to confront tyranny.
